title: Shopping
hook: 佩奇和乔治跟着妈妈去超市，照着清单买东西，猪爸爸却偷偷往车里放了巧克力蛋糕。

cells.q: Where are Peppa and George going?
cells.a: They are going shopping with Mummy Pig.
cells.cn: 他们跟猪妈妈一起去超市买东西。

cells.a: Yes, Peppa and George love going shopping.
cells.cn: 喜欢，佩奇和乔治很喜欢逛超市。

cells.a: Spaghetti is Peppa and George's favourite food.
cells.cn: 意大利面是他们最爱吃的。

cells.q: What did Peppa teach George to say?
cells.a: She taught him to say the word spa-ghe-tti.
cells.cn: 她教他说“意大利面”这个词。

cells.a: Because crisps are not on the shopping list.
cells.cn: 因为薯片不在购物清单上。

cells.q: What is next on the list?
cells.a: The next thing on the list is onions.
cells.cn: 清单上下一样要买的是洋葱。

cells.a: He can choose the fruit, like apples or a melon.
cells.cn: 他可以挑水果，比如苹果或大甜瓜。

cells.q: Where do they pay for the food?
cells.a: They pay for all the food at the checkout.
cells.cn: 他们在收银台为所有东西付钱。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig want to buy?
cells.a: A chocolate cake, so he pretends it was on the list.
cells.cn: 他想要巧克力蛋糕，就说假装清单上有它。
